items.text: Ton lived in Ironsway in Bavland and worked the nearby mines. He was drinking with Amark and other miners when Took and Szeth came into the tavern, where Took showed off Szeth's Oathstone. When Took told Szeth to pour out Ton's beer, Ton objected to wasting it. Szeth's way of speaking took him by surprise, as he knew nothing of people from Shinovar.

appearance.text: Like the other miners, he was usually caked in dirt and grime.

personality.text: Off work he liked a beer in the local tavern, and he spoke with a Bav accent.
